sourceName: Popular Names by Country community dataset
licenseName: CC0 for the repository dataset; upstream Wikipedia lists retain CC BY-SA 4.0 provenance
version: v1.2 surname CSV; Wikipedia lists collected during the week of 2023-07-08

auxiliarySources.version: capture used for ISO2 to Natural Earth numeric joins
auxiliarySources.purpose: Map source ISO2 codes to the Natural Earth numeric country ids used by the globe.

attribution: Community-compiled surname records from the v1.2 dataset; underlying Wikipedia list provenance remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
transformations: Keep every source country and Rank=1 rows; preserve source-listed unranked rows when a country has no numeric rank, without presenting them as ranked results
Group alternate local and romanized spellings by source Name Group and preserve tied variants as arrays
Join ISO2 source codes to Natural Earth numeric ids with the pinned GeoNames countryInfo capture
Keep source count and percent only when present; no year is inferred from the source snapshot
Add only a small manually reviewed Chinese presentation set; all other Chinese fields remain null
missingValuePolicy: Missing rank-one records, unranked source lists, counts, shares, years, local spellings, romanizations, and Chinese presentations remain explicit null or empty arrays and are never imputed.
boundaryPolicy: A community-compiled source-listed observation, not a unified official global surname ranking or a census comparison.
coverageNote: Community-compiled source-listed records, not a unified official global ranking. Numeric rank-one records are absent for some countries; their unranked source lists remain visible without an inferred rank.
